description: Register an Android app's package name with an instance, like adding an Android app on the Clerk Dashboard's Native applications page. Returns the registered app, with its id, package_name, namespace, and fingerprints. Clerk needs the registration for native sign-in with Clerk's Android SDK, and before patch_instance_config can set the app's minimum version (native_app_minimum_versions). Check list_native_applications first: a package name that's already registered is rejected. To change or remove a registration, use the Clerk Dashboard. Then run enable_native_api if it isn't enabled.

fingerprints.description: SHA-256 fingerprints of the app's signing certificates, such as 14:6D:E9:…. Passkeys need them; omit them otherwise.

instance.description: Instance to target: "development", "production", or a full instance ID (ins_…).

namespace.description: The Digital Asset Links namespace. Omit it to use android_app, which almost every app uses.

package_name.description: The app's package name (its applicationId), such as com.example.app.

name: create_android_application
title: Register an Android application
